name: EK Draconis
description: A star 0.94 solar radii and 0.95 solar masses that turns once in 2.77 days; its magnetic field has been mapped.

radius.source: Waite et al., arXiv:1611.07751, Table 1: radius 0.94 solar radii

mass.source: Waite et al., arXiv:1611.07751, Table 1: mass 0.95 solar masses

temperature.source: TESS Input Catalog 8.2 (VizieR IV/39/tic82), TIC 159613900: Teff

spin.source: Waite et al., arXiv:1611.07751, Table 1: rotation period 2.766 d and an axis 60 degrees from the line of sight, the values its magnetic maps were made with

color.reason: The Washington Double Star catalogue (Mason et al. 2001, AJ 122, 3466; VizieR B/wds/wds) lists WDS 14390+6417 KON 1: 0.8 arcsec apart, magnitudes 6 and 8.9: the companion gives 6.5% of the light, which a measured spectrum would blend with the star's. The color is the Planck spectrum at the star's temperature

text.card: A star 94% of the Sun's width that turns once in 2.77 days, with a mapped magnetic field.
text.introduction: Waite et al. give it 0.94 solar radii, 0.95 solar masses, a rotation period of 2.77 days and an axis tilted 60° from the line of sight.
